incident-bot: PAGER: P1 - inference-us-west - sustained 95th pct latency spikes > 3s. Pager sent to rotation. Created incident thread.
Priya S.: I'm on call and seeing the alert, joining war room. link: https://meet.redwood.ai/warroom/uvw123
Carlos M.: Thanks Priya. Can you confirm impact surface? Any customer-facing errors or just latency?
Priya S.: No 5xxs in logs, mostly tail latency on text-gen models, some requests timing out at edge clients. Asha, can you pull statuspage draft?
Asha R.: Draft below — please edit.
Asha R.: ```
[Status] Investigating: Elevated inference latency in us-west.
[Impact] Intermittent increased response times for text-generation endpoints (10-30% of requests experiencing 3-12s additional latency). No data loss reported.
[Mitigation] Routing fallback to smaller model while we validate KV cache pressure.
[ETA] Updates every 15 minutes or earlier if new info.
```
Jen K.: Quick check: are we seeing KV cache evictions in the runtime? Carlos, can you confirm memstats?
Carlos M.: Seeing spike in KV cache misses and CPU on gpu-pool-3. Posting snippet: ```vmstat 1 5
procs -----------memory---------- ---swap-- -----io---- -system-- ------cpu-----
 r  b   swpd   free   buff  cache   si   so    bi    bo   in   cs us sy id wa st
 3  0      0  120M   45M   600M    0    0    50   120  100  230 60 30  5  5  0
```
Mike L.: I'll toggle routing to fallback model for traffic from eu/us-west with a canary rule. Doing: `route --set fallback-model=redwood-v2-small --percent=20 --region=us-west`
Priya S.: Ack, make it 30% if safe. Also start ingesting slow-requests sample: `logs query --tail 100 --filter "latency>2000"`
Asha R.: Customer notifier (short): "We're investigating increased latency impacting text generation in US-West. Some requests may be slower. We're routing traffic to a fallback model and will update within 15 minutes." Thoughts?
Jen K.: Good. Add support contact line and minimize technical detail.
Asha R.: Updated notifier: "We are investigating elevated latency affecting text generation in US‑West. Some requests may experience slower responses. Our team has applied a temporary routing fix; updates every 15 minutes. Contact support@redwood.ai for urgent issues."
Carlos M.: Owner assigned: Carlos M. (runtime). Action list: 1) Confirm KV cache pressure cause 2) Validate fallback correctness 3) Monitor error rates and latency 4) Prepare rollback plan.
Priya S.: Oncall handoff: Priya S. -> Jen K. in 45m. Jen, will you take next shift?
Jen K.: I can take the handoff; will be on-call in 45 and stay looped.
Mike L.: Routing change live. Monitoring metrics. If we see errors spike, revert.
incident-bot: NOTE: Pager acknowledged by Priya S. at 2098765440.
Priya S.: Quick ask for comms: can someone draft a short internal update for ENG and CS? I can push to #all-hands-prod if approved.
Asha R.: Internal update draft: "We are investigating elevated inference latency in us-west. Impact: increased response times for text-generation. Mitigation: routing partial traffic to fallback model; runtime team investigating KV cache pressure. No customer-facing errors reported. Owner: Carlos M. Next update in 15 minutes."
Carlos M.: Looks good. :thumbsup:
Priya S.: Ok pushing to status page and notifying support. Will post next update at 2098765568 or sooner.
Jen K.: I'll take the handoff if anything changes before then.
Mike L.: I'll keep watch on autoscaler thresholds and GPU health.
Asha R.: Noted. Closing loop on initial kickoff — war room link is pinned in the channel.
